meta.what: Russia's federal budget total expenditure and balance (monthly and yearly 2019 to the latest month), % of GDP, National Wealth Fund total and liquid assets, and the 2026 budget law, in-year plan and Minfin estimate. Research only; not wired into the build. Extends russia_revenue_r58 (revenue, oil and gas share, defence context).
meta.units: RUB bn and EUR bn nominal; balance: deficit negative, surplus positive; shares as fractions
meta.fx: Budget flows: simple monthly average of Bank of Russia official daily EUR rates; yearly EUR = sum of monthly conversions. NWF stocks: Bank of Russia EUR rate applying on the as-of date.
meta.gdp: Rosstat annual nominal GDP as republished in World Bank WDI (2019-2025). 2026: GDP implied by Minfin's September 2026 estimate (7.345 trn = 3.2% of GDP), about 229.5 trn; the 2026 law assumed 235.067 trn. Monthly balance_pct_annual_gdp = month / that year's GDP (not seasonally meaningful); ytd_balance_pct_gdp = cumulative / full-year GDP, Minfin's convention for in-year ratios.
meta.nwf_liquid: Liquid assets = NWF funds on accounts at the Bank of Russia (yuan, gold, roubles; dollars, euros and pounds before they were sold off) = total volume minus 'иные разрешенные активы' (deposits at VEB, shares such as Sberbank and Aeroflot, bonds of companies). Matches Minfin's stated liquid volume on 1 Apr 2026 (3,889 bn) and 1 Oct 2025 (4,165 bn).
meta.labels: monthly/yearly/nwf = execution or stock data; plans.* = law, in-year plan, estimate or draft, as labelled in 'kind'/'status'.

2026.label: Updated spending plan in the 'Электронный бюджет' system, 13 Jul 2026 (no amending law; spring amendments were skipped)
Minfin estimate for 2026 published with the 2027-2029 draft budget (submitted 30 Sep 2026)
2026.note: Deficit and % of GDP as stated (Interfax). Revenue and expenditure are back-calculated from Kommersant's '2027 revenue +5% to 43.3 trn' and 'expenditure +0.4% to 48.8 trn' (rounded inputs, about ±0.1 trn); search summaries of other outlets give about 41.2 and 48.5 trn.

2026_execution_to_date.note: Jan-Sep deficit already exceeds the full-year law deficit; ratios are descriptive, not forecasts.

draft_2027_2029_submitted_2026-09-30.status: draft bill; first Duma reading scheduled for 29 Oct 2026 (Kommersant)

nwf_statements.text: NWF to be replenished by RUB 0.6-1 trn over 2026; liquid part about RUB 5 trn at end-2026 (statement)
NWF not to be used to finance the deficit in 2027-2029; no withdrawals planned in 2027 and the fund to grow by RUB 1.1 trn in 2027
